subject: [hw] DONE P04: hardware H.264/HEVC VideoToolbox encoder objects; 5029 checks; iOS compile 4/4
body:
DONE P04. Host-tested only; no phone, nothing published, no commit outside gpu/hwcodec/vt/**.

  bash gpu/hwcodec/vt/test/run_tests.sh
  -> N2TEST P04 PASS 5029/5029
     annexb.c ASan+UBSan 725, -O2 725; encoder object ASan+UBSan 1193, -O2 1193, TSan 1193;
     P04 ios compile: 4/4 objects for arm64-apple-ios16.0 (build_ios.sh flags, -Werror).

What was built (files, all new):
  vt/annexb.c, vt/n2hwenc_annexb.h - Annex B scan/classify, in-place Annex B -> AVCC (parameter sets optionally stripped), avcC and hvcC builders from ISO/IEC 14496-15, original code.
  vt/n2hwenc_vt.c - one n2vt_abi.h encoder object for 'avc1' and 'hvc1'/'hev1': StartSession (connect + OPEN with the session size and properties), EncodeFrame (NV12 -> vcodecd, parameter-set stripping, AVCC, format description from the first key frame, one CMSampleBuffer per frame with n2avc_vt.c's NotSync/DependsOnOthers), property set/copy/supported dictionary (AverageBitRate/ExpectedFrameRate -> ENC_SET, gop/ProfileLevel/RealTime -> one reopen before the first picture), CompleteFrames, Invalidate, finalize. Unreachable daemon -> -12915 (kVTVideoEncoderNotAvailableNowErr) so the software encoder stays the fallback.
  vt/n2hwenc_client.c/.h - the function-pointer seam; the default table maps 1:1 on P03's final client/n2vcd_client.h (connect_path/status_errno/enc_open/session bytes/enc_frame/enc_set/close/disconnect), all weak, so a link without client/ still works and reports absent.
  vt/n2hwenc_register.c, vt/n2hwenc_vt.h - n2hwavc_vt_create / n2hwhevc_vt_create and n2hwenc_register_all() (IsHardwareAccelerated=true, Rating=100, avc1/hvc1/hev1), optional HELLO probe, trace hook (library never prints).
  vt/symbols.txt, vt/STATUS.md, vt/test/{run_tests.sh, mp4_extract.py, t_annexb.c, t_vt.c, t_fakeclient.c/.h, t_support.c/.h}, dsh-state/workers/P04/STATUS.md.

The oracle is ffmpeg itself: three streams (AVC High, AVC Baseline, HEVC Main, 25 frames, keyint 10) muxed to MP4 with -c copy; mp4_extract.py copies the avcC/hvcC boxes and each picture's length-prefixed sample out, annexb.c must rebuild both byte for byte. The object half runs against gpu/video/fake with a canned vcodecd client playing the same vectors.

Not done (full list in vt/STATUS.md):
  - build_ios.sh does not compile these four objects yet and SLIMEncoderRegister does not call n2hwenc_register_all() yet; I posted the exact lines to hw-ip. 'Compiled for iOS' is verified; 'linked into Slim.videoencoder' and 'run on the phone' are not.
  - -12915 as the status the VideoToolbox selection loop retries on is [I] (documented meaning + the plan's loop note); a phone run with vcodecd absent must witness the software fallback. Recommend gating the registration on a switch file until M4c encodes on the phone.
  - CMVideoFormatDescriptionCreateFromHEVCParameterSets is not in n2_apple.h/fake_apple.c; declared in vt/n2hwenc_vt.h, implemented test-locally, listed in symbols.txt, asked to hw-lead.
  - NV12 only (y420 refused), synchronous one-sample-per-frame, one hardware session per object, structural property changes before the first picture cost one reopen.
  - no phone test of any kind.

Staying available for review findings and for hw-ip's link.
